scenario: AdaptixC2 v1.2 Windows HTTP/S Beacon, server-side fingerprint, modified-header 404 claim, and inert signed-host DLL sideload verification

kali.role: exclusive build, C2, listener, staging, and operator host

nsm.role: offline pcap analysis and lab-only active JARM

unused: VM 102 AI as an execution host
VM 108 orchestrator as an execution host

tool.name: AdaptixC2
tool.build_and_execution_location: Kali VM 100 only for server/extender build and server runtime; reviewed generated PEs ran only on Windows VM 104

flows.name: default HTTP Beacon
operator_actions: create default clear BeaconHTTP listener
generate and separately triage x64 Beacon with 10-second sleep/20% jitter
stage on Kali
download and hash-check under an unrelated target filename
execute as SYSTEM
run getuid, pwd, ls C:\lab, ps list, and fixed-marker download
terminate and collect

observed_signals.process: unversioned renamed agent under PowerShell; no task children
observed_signals.network: 11 POSTs over one keepalive connection with three default paths and exact legacy Firefox UA
observed_signals.file: curl PE write, prefetch, fixed-marker round trip
observed_signals.registry: generic WinINet cache and policy-key access

flows.name: default teamserver and listener 404 fingerprints
operator_actions: request an unregistered TLS teamserver path from VM 104
request an unregistered default clear-listener path
save exact target-side headers and bodies
inspect pcap and NSM

observed_signals.network: exact default headers and bodies; clear listener content present in pcap

flows.name: modified-header 404 test
operator_actions: create a listener with Server nginx and X-Lab-Profile modified headers
repeat target-side 404 request
run the same Suricata body rule against default and modified pcaps

observed_signals.network: body remained byte-identical and content rule matched both pcaps

flows.name: default HTTPS Beacon
operator_actions: create default TLS BeaconHTTP listener
generate and separately triage x64 Beacon
stage, download, hash-check, and execute under an unrelated filename
run getuid and ls C:\lab
measure passive JA3/JA3S and active JARM
terminate and collect

observed_signals.network: repeated TLS 1.2 flows at approximately 10 seconds; JA3/JA3S captured; all-zero JARM

flows.stock_go_comparison: JA3 did not match the supplied Go 1.24+ value; no TLS rule shipped because the observed pair is generic Windows/SChannel plus routine Go TLS server behavior.

flows.name: lab-authored inert DLL sideload
operator_actions: compile inert faultrep.dll on Kali
copy and validate signed WerFault.exe from the baseline
place DLL beside host
execute host with -?
verify fixed marker, signatures, hashes, Sysmon, and pcap

observed_signals.process: signed WerFault.exe executed from non-system directory
observed_signals.file: host, faultrep.dll, and marker file events
observed_signals.deep: no EID 7 because baseline image-load logging is disabled

evidence.description: Sanitized pcap hashes, exact HTTP artifacts, cadence, JA3/JA3S/JARM, NSM versions, and alert summaries.
Sanitized Windows five-dimension signals and exact bounded task outcomes.
Signed-host, inert-DLL, marker, telemetry, and zero-network results.
SigmaHQ master commit, zero Adaptix mentions, and generic-rule results against captured fields.
Human source review, provenance, exclusions, and safe-after-modification verdict.
Pre-execution scope gate; no critical findings.
Post-execution PASS and Windows Sysmon EID 3 process attribution.

sigma.positive_evidence: native content rule matched default and modified pcaps

generic_fired: Creation of WerFault.exe/Wer.dll in Unusual Folder
Files With System Process Name In Unsuspected Locations
generic_not_observable: Potential System DLL Sideloading From Non System Locations because Sysmon EID 7 was disabled

validation.generated_agent_static_analysis: two separate mechanical triage plus REMnux file/PE/strings/Ghidra reviews completed before target execution
validation.periodicity: measured but recorded as a backend correlation requirement; not expressible in a single-event Sigma rule

detection_limitations: BeaconHTTP profiles and response headers are operator-configurable.
The body rule requires response-body extraction or a native Suricata rule because default EVE HTTP output does not retain body content.
The TLS JA3/JA3S pair is not AdaptixC2-specific and JARM returned all zeros.
Sysmon EID 7 was disabled, so the upstream image-load sideload rule could not be exercised.
Single-event Sigma cannot assert periodicity; production intervals must be parameterized.

lab_capability_gaps.reason: requires a public cloud endpoint and is categorically forbidden by Safety Rule 1
